Awl Software Development Kit [Beta]
Usage:
  awl                         Show this help
  awl init NAME               Create NAME.awproj and, if absent, main.aw here
  awl build                   Build the sole .awproj project here
  awl build NAME              Find NAME.awproj in an immediate child folder
  awl build relative/file.aw   Compile a single .aw file (imports supported)

Build options:
  -o FILE                      Executable destination (relative to terminal cwd)
  -O 0|1|2|3                   Optimization level (default 2)
  --syntax next|legacy         Override manifest / single-file default next
  --build-timeout 1..3600       Backend timeout in seconds (default 120)
  --build-memory-mib 512..16384 Backend memory bound (default 4096)

Project output: <project>/build/<manifest-name> (.exe on Windows).
Single-file output: <cwd>/<source-stem> (.exe on Windows).
Init never overwrites existing files. NAME: 1..64 letters/digits/_/-, starts alphanumeric.
Compilation needs the complete bundled backend, not Python or a host compiler.
Only initialization and compilation are included; no run/install commands yet.
